017package org.apache.juneau.console;
018
019import java.util.*;
020
021import org.apache.juneau.marshall.collections.*;
022
023/**
024 * The built-in {@code html} card type: markup-only (JSON5 bodies are E-25), with an optional body auto-captured
025 * as a {@code <template data-card="{id}">}. A bare {@code html} card (no body) emits an empty fragment — the
026 * shell paints an empty {@code .jc-card} and nothing more.
027 *
028 * <h5 class='section'>Trust boundary for {@code src}:</h5>
029 * <p>
030 * An {@code html} card in a page contract may instead name a {@code src} endpoint. The {@code src} must be a
031 * same-origin path (checked at page build, by {@code PageCapture.addCard} for FreeMarker and {@code PageSpec} cards
032 * and by {@code CardTypeRegistry.toCard} for lifted ones; the shell checks it again before the fetch). The shell
033 * fetches it and inserts the returned HTML as-is, <b>unsanitized</b>, the same trust level as
034 * {@code footer.text}. The endpoint must therefore be a trusted first-party route, must never be derived from request
035 * data, and must escape any data it embeds in the fragment.
036 *
037 * <p>
038 * A card that cannot guarantee that can opt in with {@code "sanitize": true} (or {@code sanitize=true} on
039 * {@code <@card>}, or {@code CardSpec.sanitize(true)}). The shell then rebuilds the fetched fragment through the views
040 * attribute-allowlist sanitizer, the one behind the {@code SANITIZED_HTML} detail format, so script, {@code on*}
041 * handlers, unsafe URLs and unlisted attributes are dropped. The page must load the views toolkit; without it the
042 * card fails closed with E-JS-8 and paints nothing. The flag only affects {@code src} cards, and the default is
043 * unchanged (unsanitized).
044 *
045 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
046 * <p class='bjava'>
047 *   CardSource <jv>s</jv> = CardSource.<jsm>create</jsm>(<js>"html"</js>, <js>"welcome"</js>)
048 *     .title(<js>"Welcome"</js>)
049 *     .body(<js>"&lt;p&gt;Hello!&lt;/p&gt;"</js>)
050 *     .templateSink(<jv>page</jv>::captureTemplate)
051 *     .build();
052 *   JsonMap <jv>frag</jv> = <jk>new</jk> HtmlCardType().toFragment(<jv>s</jv>);  <jc>// {"template":"welcome"}</jc>
053 * </p>
054 *
055 * @since 10.0.0
056 */
057public final class HtmlCardType implements CardTypeHandler {
058
059   @Override
060   public String type() {
061      return "html";
062   }
063
064   /** An html card is markup: it takes only the shell's {@code refresh} / {@code params} roles. */
065   @Override
066   public Set<String> acceptedRoles() {
067      return Set.of();
068   }
069
070   /** An html card handles only the shell's {@code refresh} op. */
071   @Override
072   public Set<String> acceptedOps() {
073      return Set.of();
074   }
075
076   @Override
077   public JsonMap toFragment(CardSource source) {
078      if (source.hasJsonBody()) {
079         var body = source.body();
080         var shortBody = body != null && body.length() > 40 ? body.substring(0, 40) : body;
081         var preview = body == null ? "" : shortBody;
082         throw source.error("type='%s' requires a %s body; got '%s'.", "html", "markup", preview);
083      }
084      var frag = new JsonMap();
085      if (source.body() != null && ! source.body().isEmpty())
086         frag.put("template", source.captureTemplate());
087      return frag;
088   }
089}
